Class SpatialConnector

java.lang.Object
org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.spatial.iceberg.connector.SpatialConnector
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.trino.spi.connector.Connector
public class SpatialConnector extends Object implements io.trino.spi.connector.Connector
Wraps Trino's built-in Iceberg connector, overriding only getMetadata() to inject spatial-predicate pushdown (SpatialConnectorMetadata). All other methods delegate to the underlying connector so Iceberg's session properties, capabilities, procedures, page-source provider, and write support are fully exposed.

    • SpatialConnector

      public SpatialConnector(io.trino.spi.connector.Connector delegate, String catalogName, AuthorizationResolver resolver)
      Wraps a delegate connector, optionally installing Trino-layer row-visibility enforcement.
      Parameters:
      delegate - the underlying iceberg connector
      catalogName - the Trino catalog name (for the injected row filter's ViewExpression); may be null when no resolver.
      resolver - identity→auths resolver; when non-null, Trino-layer row-visibility enforcement is installed. When null, access control delegates to Iceberg (no extra filter).

    • SpatialConnector

      public SpatialConnector(io.trino.spi.connector.Connector delegate, String catalogName, AuthorizationResolver resolver, boolean bboxShortCircuit)
      Wraps a delegate connector, optionally installing Trino-layer row-visibility enforcement and the page-source bbox cheap-reject.
      Parameters:
      delegate - the underlying iceberg connector
      catalogName - the Trino catalog name; may be null when no resolver.
      resolver - identity→auths resolver; null disables Trino-layer enforcement.
      bboxShortCircuit - when true, wrap the page source with the bbox cheap-reject (SpatialPageSourceProvider).
